root_cause_reading.cause: The rc.7 headless composition supplied tools but no agent-presets provider row, while both the loader entry and runner declared only hmr; Cordis therefore had no dependency gate for agentPresets or tools before runner activation.
root_cause_reading.future_exact_patch: Add the official @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets row with default standard and require ordered hmr, agentPresets, tools in both the loader-entry injection and runner module injection.
root_cause_reading.remaining_gate: emr4-bounded-worker is not a shipped rc.7 preset and remains unmaterialised; no future native boot is authorised by this tranche.

independent_review.finding_1: The provider-free pytest wrapper removed LOCALAPPDATA while the controller required it, causing seven current-suite failures in an isolated worktree.
independent_review.finding_2: The first verifier manifest included an accepted predecessor test whose physical untracked docs/branding assertion cannot transfer into a clean Git worktree.
independent_review.first_corrected_transport_reason: The reviewer executed all ten commands successfully and wrote a substantive pass review but inserted diff into the reported C10 argv, so exact local manifest admission rejected the envelope.

honest_build_cost.candidate_source_correction_reason: Add an owned-cache fallback for stripped LOCALAPPDATA and two focused tests without expanding provider-free passthrough.
honest_build_cost.verifier_manifest_correction_reason: Exclude only the non-transferable predecessor evidence test while directly retaining both predecessor attempt hashes and failed terminals in the current suite.
diagnostic_command_notes: One source-inspection command required explicit UTF-8 console output after Windows rejected a Unicode character.
One Antigravity help invocation used the script path instead of the package module and was immediately corrected to python -m scripts.ariadne_antigravity.
test_authoring_notes: Two report-whitespace assertions were corrected without changing the product claim.
One negative cache-root test used an ancestry that still contained the real user cache and was replaced with a closed drive-root fixture.
prepublication_clockwork_intent_validati: The first dry reading rejected a path string placed in contract_evidence, which accepts structured contract-evidence objects; the redundant entry was removed before any canonical write.
The second dry reading rejected the non-canonical role independent_reviewer; the incident now uses the register's verifier enum.

After rollback, a redundant python -c companion-note check was rejected because clockwork command manifests admit python -m entries only; the command was removed because incident evidence-path validation already requires the note to exist.
honest_build_cost.post_publication_compatibility_correctio: The first publication derived register revision 568 but the caller omitted the required human-readable versioned revision note; the post-publication suite failed and clockwork restored the preceding generation byte-exactly before the note and prepublication check were added.
honest_build_cost.rollback_invocation_note: The first rollback command incorrectly supplied --intent; the CLI rejected it without mutation and the exact no-intent rollback then passed byte-exactly.
honest_build_cost.rollback_source_rebind_note: A dry reading correctly refused physical pointer drift until the clockwork-written rollback pointer was included in the next exact Git source.

rerun_assessment.conclusion: The mechanism reduced ambiguity rather than hiding cost: two semantic defects and one machine-envelope mismatch were each isolated, preserved and corrected; the exact candidate then passed one admissible fresh veto without any native Harness retry.
